page.layout: One printed page: running text in one main column with italic verse stanzas; narrow marginal notes at the right margin, set in several short columns running down the right side (the first note column starts at the top, a second note group sits lower beside "Præceptum").

main_text.p: tho labores illis remittere & quietem concedere,vt quodammodo refectis viribus diurno labori & operibus extraordinariis possint suf-ficere.

Qua in re summam Dei nostri benignitatem considerare nos operæ pretium est:quam non solùm erga homines patefacit, sed etiam erga ipsas bestias, quarum curam gerit, adeò vt earum & victui & quieti prouideat: & hæc quidem ideo vt hominibus vtiliores sint, in quorum commodum creatæ sunt & adhuc hodie conseruantur.subleuā-dus : qua ex re ma-gis ma-gisque commē-datur do-ctrina de prouidē-tia. Nam si Deus cura ge-rit animalium, annon multò magisho minum, & maxi-mè filio-rū suorū geret?Quod etiam Dauid diligenter animaduertit,& his verbis expressit, Ps. 36.

p.i: Quàm tua summe Deus bonitas micet æthere toto,

l.i: Et qua Cunctipotens hominésque ferâsque gubernas,
Inter at ista tuas quanta est, Deus optime, laudes,
Mortales, velut alarum sub tegmine fœtus
Delicisque tuis saturos, dimittis ad amnes
Pleno vbi voluptas pura manat alueo.

main_text.p: Fuit præterea vetitum in Lege,ne simul arare-tur boue & asino.Præce-ptum de coniun-ctionib. illicitis in me-moriam reducit. Quo præcepto docere nos Deus voluit, quanti faciat concordiam non solùm inter homines, sed etiam inter bestias, quas natura differentes & diuersas noluit si-

page.notes: Marginal notes at right are set in narrow columns and are transcribed in order within the paragraphs they stand beside; the two note groups are split by the line of text. Some words in the notes are doubtful due to the narrow setting; the ornamental long-s and ligatures in the verse are rendered as plain letters.
